# `scripts/fp/ui/`

[Index](index.md)

## `scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel.gd`

extends `Control`

The global chat panel (slice C §2), Clash of Clans style: a drawer that slides out of the left edge of chat_slot (440 px) with a 20 px edge tab and an unread badge, City / District tabs, the pinned Gazette headline, one row per message (round avatar, role-coloured name, district badge, relative time, reply arrow) or a tinted system card, a "New messages" pill while scrolled up and the input line. Closed, the last three messages fade out as a ticker above the minimap. Rows are appended and never re-rendered; only their time labels refresh every 10 s of feed time.

### Signals

- `submitted(text: String)`: The player sent a line (already trimmed, at most INPUT_MAX characters).
- `open_changed(open: bool)`: The drawer opened (true) or closed (false).

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel_style.gd")`
- `W = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel_widgets.gd")`
- `ROW = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel_row.gd")`
- `TICKER = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel_ticker.gd")`
- `T = preload("res://scripts/fp/chat/chat_text.gd")`
- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `PANEL_W = 440.0`
- `TAB_W = 20.0`
- `TAB_H = 64.0`
- `SLIDE_SECONDS = 0.18`
- `MAX_ROWS = 120`
- `TICKER_LINES = 3`
- `TICKER_SECONDS = 8.0`
- `TICKER_FADE = 1.2`
- `TICKER_CHARS = 118`
- `TIME_REFRESH_MS = 10000`
- `FADE_IN = 0.2`
- `INPUT_MAX = 140`
- `ROW_W = PANEL_W - 8.0`: Width rows are first shaped for (the list width with the always-on scroll bar).
- `HELP = "Enter sends, Esc closes.\nType @ and the start of a name, then Tab, to call a neighbou...`
- `MENTION_TILES = 10.0`: Residents within this many tiles of the player can be @-mentioned.

### Properties

- `tab: String`: "city" or "district".
- `input: LineEdit`: The chat input line (tests focus it).

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext, p_feed: ChatFeed) -> void`: Builds the drawer, the edge tab and the ticker inside chat_slot.
- `func complete_mention() -> String`: Completes the "@na" before the caret to "@Name " with the nearest resident within MENTION_TILES whose first or last name starts with it. Returns the name, or "".
- `func open() -> void`: Slides the drawer out, pushes the &"chat" modal and focuses the input.
- `func close() -> void`: Slides the drawer back, releases the input and pops &"chat". Safe to call when closed.
- `func append(msg: Dictionary) -> void`: Appends one shown message: one row Control in the list, a ticker line while closed and the unread badge. Prunes the oldest row past MAX_ROWS.
- `func replace(msg: Dictionary) -> void`: Re-renders the row of msg in place (the Breaking card replacing its incident card).
- `func clear_rows() -> void`: Drops every row and the ticker (load, New City).
- `func rebuild(msgs: Array, p_unread: int) -> void`: Clears, then appends msgs (after a load) without touching the ticker or the badge.
- `func row_count() -> int`: Rows currently in the list (tests; never more than MAX_ROWS).
- `func rows() -> Array[ROW]`: The row Controls, oldest first (tests).
- `func on_pump(now_ms: int) -> void`: Refreshes the relative times every TIME_REFRESH_MS of feed time while open.
- `func set_player_district(d: int) -> void`: The player's district (from the tile under their feet); refilters the District tab.
- `func set_pinned(paper: Dictionary) -> void`: Shows the pinned Gazette (paper: {"headline", "editorial", "stories": [{"title", "body"}], "day"}, already filtered); {} hides it.
- `func pinned_text() -> String`: The pinned headline text ("" when none).
- `func set_typing(on: bool, names: Array[String]) -> void`: Shows the typing row above the input while on: "<names> is typing…" (ChatText.typing_line; names are who answers next, soonest first, "Someone" while nobody is known yet).
- `func typing_text() -> String`: The typing row's text ("" while it is hidden).

## `scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel_row.gd`

extends `Control`

One chat message drawn as a single Control (slice C §2): a resident, mayor, press, council or player row (round avatar, role-coloured name, role tag and district chips, job, relative time, reply arrow with a quote of the parent, word-wrapped text in a speech bubble) or a full-width system card (tinted, accent rim, icon, title, time, text). Text is shaped once with TextServer lines; a width change reflows the paragraph, a time refresh redraws only the time.

- `CHIP_H = 15.0`

- `INCIDENT_ICONS = { "fire": "fire", "blackout": "bolt", "power_line": "bolt", "sewage_burst": "drop", "wa...`: Card icon per incident type (refs.type).

### Properties

- `msg: Dictionary`: The message this row shows.
- `t_ms: int`: Feed time the message was shown (for the relative time).
- `district: int`: District used by the District tab (-1: city-wide).

### Functions

- `func setup(p_msg: Dictionary, parent: Dictionary, w: float, time_text: String, row_district: int) -> void`: Shapes msg for width w. parent: {"author", "text"} of the message it replies to, or {}. row_district: the district the District tab files it under.
- `func set_msg(p_msg: Dictionary, parent: Dictionary, time_text: String) -> void`: Replaces the message in place (the Breaking card replacing its incident card).
- `func set_time(time_text: String) -> void`: Refreshes the relative time (the only thing that changes after a row is shown).
- `func text() -> String`: The visible text (tests and tooltips).

- `static func text_line(text: String, font: Font, size: int) -> TextLine`: A shaped single line of text (TextServer, no node).
- `static func text_para(text: String, font: Font, size: int, width: float) -> TextParagraph`: A shaped, word-wrapped paragraph of the given width.

## `scripts/fp/ui/fp_hud.gd`

class_name `FpHud` · extends `CanvasLayer`

The lean on-foot HUD (slice B): named slots the HUD, chat and other slices fill, and B's widgets in them: indicator chips and the compass (top_bar), toasts and the alert banner (toasts), the rotating minimap and street label (minimap_slot), the interact prompt, first-person crosshair and district caption (center), and the pause menu, place card and full map (overlay). No AI or model branding: every string goes through SimDefs.debrand(). The minimap and map need the hud_widgets feature, which binds its tile model and waypoint with bind_widgets().

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `Chips = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_chips.gd")`
- `Toasts = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_toasts.gd")`
- `Compass = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_compass.gd")`
- `MinimapView = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/minimap_view.gd")`
- `Prompt = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_prompt.gd")`
- `Caption = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_caption.gd")`
- `PauseMenu = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/pause_menu.gd")`
- `PlaceCard = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/place_card.gd")`
- `MapScreen = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/map_screen.gd")`
- `SLOTS = ["top_bar", "minimap_slot", "chat_slot", "center", "toasts", "overlay"]`
- `SLOT_RECTS = { "top_bar": [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 16, 12, -16, 64], "minimap_slot": [0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0...`: [anchor_left, anchor_top, anchor_right, anchor_bottom, offset_left, offset_top, offset_right, offset_bottom] in the 1600x900 base viewport (canvas_items stretch).
- `PING_LIFE = 30.0`: Seconds a ping marker lives on the minimap and compass (it fades over the last third).
- `MAX_PINGS = 8`
- `EVENT_NOUNS = { "fire": "Fire", "blackout": "Power plant failure", "sewage_burst": "Sewage main burst...`: Short names for incident banners ("Fire reported near 214 Maple Street").

### Properties

- `widgets: FpFeature`: The hud_widgets feature once bound (minimap model and waypoint), else null.
- `pings: Array[Dictionary]`: Live pings: {"pos": Vector3, "reason": String, "age": float, "alpha": float}, oldest first.

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`: Builds the slots and every widget and connects to the bus.
- `func slot(slot_name: String) -> Control`: The slot Control by name (one of SLOTS); asserts on unknown names.
- `func set_hud_visible(v: bool) -> void`: Hides or shows every slot except "overlay" (F1 and photo mode).
- `func is_hud_visible() -> bool`: True unless set_hud_visible(false) hid the slots.
- `func show_toast(text: String, kind: String = "info") -> v`: Queues a toast in the "toasts" slot. kind: info|alert|success|system|chat.
- `func bind_widgets(f: FpFeature) -> void`: Binds the hud_widgets feature: its model feeds the minimap and map, its waypoint the compass.
- `func unbind_widgets() -> void`: Drops the feature binding (feature teardown).
- `func waypoint() -> Variant`: The waypoint (Vector3 at y = 0) or null.
- `func route() -> PackedVector2Array`: The road route to the waypoint as world (x, z) points (empty without a waypoint).
- `func set_waypoint(p: Vector3) -> void`: Sets the waypoint and announces it as a "player" ping (the map's left click).
- `func clear_waypoint() -> void`: Clears the waypoint.
- `func close_transient() -> void`: Closes the place card and the full map and pops their modals (world_ready, load, New City).

## `scripts/fp/ui/gps_route.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

GPS route for the waypoint (slice B): a breadth-first search over road tiles from the road nearest the player to the road nearest the waypoint, returned as world points (x, z) with only the corners kept: the player, every turn, the waypoint. Empty when either end has no road within reach or the roads do not connect.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `N4 = [Vector2i(0, -1), Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(-1, 0)]`
- `REACH = 4`: Tiles searched around each end for a road.

### Functions

- `static func find(sim: CitySim, a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> PackedVector2Array`: Route from world point a to world point b along roads, as world (x, z) points.
- `static func near_road(sim: CitySim, p: Vector3) -> int`: The road tile nearest world point p within REACH tiles, or -1.

## `scripts/fp/ui/hud_caption.gd`

extends `Control`

District caption (slice B), bottom right of the "center" slot: on arrival and whenever the player walks into another district, its name in the display face with its mayor under it, sliding in over 0.4 s, held for 4 s and faded out. Water and bridges never change it, and a district shown in the last COOLDOWN seconds is not shown again (no flicker along a border). Hidden under modals, during a conversation and in photo mode.

### Constants

- `COOLDOWN = 45.0`

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func arrive() -> void`: Shows the caption for the player's district now (spawn, load, New City), cooldown or not.
- `func check() -> void`: Reads the player's district and shows its caption when it changed (and is off cooldown).
- `func show_district(d: int) -> void`: Shows the caption for district d (-1: unclaimed land).
- `func caption_text() -> String`: The caption text while it shows ("" otherwise).

## `scripts/fp/ui/hud_chips.gd`

extends `Control`

Top-centre indicator chips (slice B): population, mood and treasury on the left of the clock chip (day, time, speed); power, water, alerts and the "City hall in session" dot on its right, so the clock stays centred while the alert chips come and go. Values refresh on stats_updated and time_scale_changed and at 4 Hz for the clock; a changed value pulses its chip for 0.3 s, and only a new incident blinks (the alerts chip, twice).

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `HudIcon = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_icon.gd")`
- `REFRESH = 0.25`
- `PULSE = 0.3`
- `BLINK = 0.9`
- `ICON_PX = 17.0`
- `VALUE_PX = 17`
- `IDS = ["pop", "mood", "money", "power", "water", "time", "alerts", "session"]`: Ids of the chips, in screen order.
- `STATE_COLORS = {"ok": S.TEXT, "good": S.GOOD, "warn": S.AMBER, "fail": S.RED}`

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`: Builds the chips and connects to the sim and bus (refreshes at once).
- `func teardown() -> void`: Disconnects from the sim (the HUD outlives nothing, but a reload keeps the same sim).
- `func refresh() -> void`: Re-reads every value from the sim, residents, sky and mode. Sets a label only when its text changed, so a 4 Hz refresh relayouts nothing in the steady state.
- `func mood_value() -> float`: Mood on the 0..10 scale: the residents' sentiment when they are active, else tile happiness.
- `func state_of(id: String) -> String`: State of a chip: "ok", "good", "warn" or "fail" (tests and the legend read it).
- `func text_of(id: String) -> String`: The value text of a chip ("1,168", "6.1", "−$3,222", "82%", "10:30", "2").
- `func chip(id: String) -> Control`: The chip's panel (tests check visibility and layout).

## `scripts/fp/ui/hud_compass.gd`

extends `Control`

Compass strip (slice B), top centre under the chips: ticks and cardinal letters for the view heading on a soft backing band, plus the waypoint and up to 3 pings drawn on the strip (a letter under a marker fades out) with their distance in metres below. Markers beyond the strip's span pin to its ends as chevrons. Redrawn when the heading moves and at 4 Hz for the distances.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `WIDTH = 460.0`
- `HEIGHT = 46.0`

- `REFRESH = 0.25`
- `LETTERS = {0: "N", 45: "NE", 90: "E", 135: "SE", 180: "S", 225: "SW", 270: "W", 315: "NW"}`

- `BAND_H = 23.0`
- `ROW_Y = BAND_TOP + BAND_H * 0.5`
- `DIST_Y = BAND_TOP + BAND_H + 12.0`

- `LABEL_GAP = 6.0`: Least space between two distance labels, and how far a label may slide from its marker.
- `LABEL_SLIDE = 24.0`
- `ORDER = {"ping": 0, "event": 1, "waypoint": 2}`: Draw order (later on top) and label priority (lower first).

### Properties

- `bearing: float`: Heading of the view, radians clockwise from north (-Z).
- `markers: Array[Dictionary]`: Each: {"bearing": float, "dist": String, "color": Color, "kind": "waypoint"|"event"|"ping", "alpha": float}

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext, p_hud: Node) -> void`: hud is the FpHud (pings and the waypoint come from it).
- `static func heading_of(f: Vector3) -> float`: Heading in radians clockwise from north for a forward vector (yaw convention of S0 §11).
- `static func bearing_to(a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> float`: Bearing from a to b, radians clockwise from north.
- `func x_of(b: float) -> float`: Screen x (local) of a bearing, or NAN outside the span.

## `scripts/fp/ui/hud_prompt.gd`

extends `Control`

Interact prompt and crosshair (slice B), in the "center" slot. Third person (D13): no crosshair, and the prompt chip ("E  Talk to Priya Gupta, nurse") floats over the target, unprojected every frame from target.pos (+0.25 m over a resident's head), clamped inside the 24 px safe margin, smoothed with a 0.05 s halflife and hidden behind the camera. - `TEXT_DIM = Color(0.86, 0.9, 0.96, 0.66)`
- `TEXT_FAINT = Color(0.86, 0.9, 0.96, 0.42)`
- `AMBER = Color("#FFB547")`
- `RED = Color("#FF5A5A")`
- `ACCENT = Color("#00E0FF")`
- `GOOD = Color("#7CE0A3")`
- `CHIP_BG = Color(0.04, 0.05, 0.08, 0.35)`: Chip backing: the most a passive indicator may have (B contract, deliverable 1).
- `PANEL_BG = Color(0.055, 0.07, 0.11, 0.78)`: Panels that hold controls (pause menu, place card, map).
- `PANEL_LINE = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.08)`
- `OUTLINE = Color(0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.62)`
- `SHADOW = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)`
- `BRAND_RE = "(?i)(Argon|DeepSeek|Kimi|Qwen|Grok|GMI|gemini|MiniMax|model|latency|cache|heuristic)"`
- `TITLE_FONT_PATH = "res://fonts/lilita_one_regular.ttf"`
- `RADIUS = 2`: Corner radius of chips, toasts, prompts and buttons, and of panels: near-square, crisp edges.
- `RADIUS_PANEL = 3`
- `CHIP_LINE = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.16)`: The hairline under a chip; a chip in a warn or fail state tints it.

### Functions

- `static func font() -> Font`: The UI font (the project's fallback sans) with tabular figures, so numbers do not jitter.
- `static func bold() -> Font`: A heavier cut of font() for values and titles.
- `static func caps() -> Font`: Tracked capitals for small headings ("SETTINGS", "CAMERA").
- `static func title() -> Font`: The game's display face (pause and map titles only).
- `static func display() -> Font`: A heavy, tightly tracked cut for HUD headlines and big numbers (district caption, speedometer).
- `static func own(n: Node) -> Node`: Marks n as created by slice B (meta OWNER_META), for the branding test and smoke.
- `static func label(t: String, size_px: int, col: Color = TEXT, f: Font = null, outline: int = 3) -> Label`: A passive label: B's font, an outline and a soft shadow so it reads on sky and asphalt.
- `static func chip_label(t: String, size_px: int, col: Color = TEXT, f: Font = null) -> Label`: A label on a chip's backing: a 2 px outline, no shadow pass.
- `static func plain(t: String, size_px: int, col: Color = TEXT, f: Font = null) -> Label`: A label for text inside a solid panel (no outline needed).
- `static func caps_label(t: String, size_px: int, col: Color = TEXT, outline: int = 2) -> Label`: Tracked capitals drawn from t; the Label keeps t as its text (only the drawing is upper-cased).
- `static func caps_width(t: String, size_px: int) -> float`: Width of t drawn by caps_label at size_px.
- `static func stripe(sb: StyleBoxFlat, col: Color, w: int = 3) -> StyleBoxFlat`: Turns sb's border into a single w px accent stripe down its left edge.
- `static func badge(t: String, col: Color, size_px: int = 11) -> PanelContainer`: A small tag that names a model or where an answer came from ("DeepSeek-V4", "LIVE"). Its label carries BADGE_META instead of OWNER_META: badges are the one place street text names a model, so the no-branding check over owned text (owned_texts) leaves them out.
- `static func ping_color(reason: String) -> Color`: Marker colour for a bus ping reason: incidents red, AI decisions in the deciding agent's colour ("ai:1" a mayor, "ai:council" a support agent), anything else amber.
- `static func box(bg: Color, radius: int, h: int, v: int, border: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0), bw: int = 0) -> StyleBoxFlat`: A StyleBoxFlat with one corner radius and content margins (h, v).
- `static func chip_box(h: int = 11, v: int = 4) -> StyleBoxFlat`: The backing behind a passive indicator chip: at most CHIP_BG, near-square, with a hairline along its bottom edge (own instance, so a chip can pulse and tint its own backing).
- `static func panel(bg: Color = PANEL_BG, radius: int = RADIUS_PANEL, h: int = 14, v: int = 10, border: Color = PANEL_LINE) -> PanelContainer`: A PanelContainer with a crisp, optionally bordered background (restyled CityHud._panel).
- `static func menu_button(t: String, size_px: int = 19) -> Button`: A menu button: flat text on idle, a light bar when focused or hovered.
- `static func pill_button(t: String, size_px: int = 15) -> Button`: A compact button (card actions, segmented choices).
- `static func key_cap(k: String, size_px: int = 13) -> PanelContainer`: A key cap ("E", "M", "Esc") for prompts and hints.
- `static func fmt(n: int) -> String`: Thousands separators: 1168 -> "1,168", -3222 -> "−3,222" (true minus sign). Restyled CityHud._fmt.
- `static func money(n: int) -> String`: Compact money: "$950", "$3.2k", "$124k", "$1.2M"; a deficit stays exact so it reads at a glance ("−$3,222", true minus sign) until it passes 100k ("−$124k").
- `static func distance(units: float) -> String`: Distance in metres from world units: "8 m", "45 m" (5 m steps from 20 m), "1.2 km".
- `static func countdown(crew_secs: float, speed: int) -> String`: "2:05": crew seconds (sim time) as minutes and seconds of real time at game speed (paused or stepping: as at speed 1).
- `static func branded(text: String) -> bool`: True when text matches the model-branding regex (the B contract's no-branding check).
- `static func owned_texts(n: Node, out: PackedStringArray = PackedStringArray()) -> PackedStringArray`: Every Label, RichTextLabel and Button text under n that slice B created (OWNER_META).
- `static func damp(halflife: float, dt: float) -> float`: Exponential smoothing factor for a halflife in seconds.

## `scripts/fp/ui/hud_toasts.gd`

extends `Control`

Toasts and the alert banner (slice B), laid out by hand in the "toasts" slot so they can slide: at most 3 toasts with a 4 s life, identical consecutive toasts collapse into one ("×2"), each slides and fades in and out over 0.2 s, and the stack closes up smoothly. A red banner for reported incidents sits above them and blinks twice on arrival. Every string is de-branded.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `HudIcon = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_icon.gd")`
- `MAX_TOASTS = 3`
- `LIFE = 4.0`
- `FADE = 0.2`
- `SLIDE_PX = 10.0`
- `GAP = 6.0`
- `MAX_TEXT_W = 560.0`: Widest toast or banner text before it ends in an ellipsis.
- `BANNER_LIFE = 6.5`
- `BANNER_BLINK = 0.8`
- `TOP = 34.0`: The slot starts at y 76; the compass and its distance labels end at y 106.
- `KIND_STYLE = { "info": ["dot", S.TEXT], "success": ["check", S.GOOD], "alert": ["alert", S.AMBER], "...`

### Functions

- `func setup() -> void`: Builds the banner; toasts are made on demand.
- `func show_toast(text: String, kind: String = "info") -> v`: Queues a toast. kind: info|alert|success|system|chat. An identical text to the newest live toast refreshes it instead (with a count).
- `func show_banner(text: String) -> void`: Shows the red alert banner (replacing any current one); it blinks twice, then holds.
- `func banner_text() -> String`: The banner text while it shows, else "".
- `func texts() -> PackedStringArray`: Texts of the live toasts, oldest first (tests).
- `func clear() -> void`: Drops every toast and the banner (reload).

## `scripts/fp/ui/hud_widgets_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

Lean HUD widgets (slice B): owns the minimap tile model and the waypoint, binds them to FpHud (minimap, full map, compass), keeps the model painted (per tile on tiles_changed, per district on territory_changed, in full on world_ready), closes B's transient UI after a load and saves the waypoint as {"waypoint": [x, z]}.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `MinimapModel = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/minimap_model.gd")`
- `GpsRoute = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/gps_route.gd")`

### Properties

- `waypoint: Vector3`: The waypoint (world, y = 0) while has_waypoint.
- `route: PackedVector2Array`: Road route from the player to the waypoint, world (x, z) corner points; empty without one.

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func on_world_rebuilt() -> void`
- `func to_dict() -> Dictionary`
- `func from_dict(d: Dictionary) -> void`
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func set_waypoint(p: Vector3) -> void`: Sets the waypoint (world point; y is ignored) and routes to it.
- `func clear_waypoint() -> void`
- `func reroute() -> void`: Recomputes the road route from the player to the waypoint (on set, on every tile the player enters, and after roads change).
- `func self_test() -> Dictionary`: The minimap texture exists at 192 x 192, the chips are present, and no text B made is branded.

## `scripts/fp/ui/map_screen.gd`

extends `Control`

Full-screen map (slice B) on M: the minimap's tile images at large size, north up, with district names, street names (from the directory) at 6 px per tile and closer, incidents, pings, the waypoint and the player. Hovering shows what is under the cursor (place, district, distance, an incident or the waypoint) in a small card. Drag pans, the wheel zooms about the cursor, a left click sets the waypoint (ping(world, "player")), a right click or a click on the waypoint clears it. Pushes the &"map" modal; M or Esc closes it (consumed). Ignored under other modals and in photo mode.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `MinimapModel = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/minimap_model.gd")`
- `MAP_SHADER = preload("res://ui/fp/map.gdshader")`
- `MODAL = &"map"`
- `MIN_PPT = 3.0`
- `MAX_PPT = 28.0`
- `START_PPT = 12.0`
- `STREET_PPT = 6.0`: Street names show at this zoom and closer.
- `ZOOM_STEP = 1.18`
- `CLICK_SLOP = 5.0`
- `FADE = 0.14`
- `MARGIN = 32.0`

### Properties

- `ppt: float`: Pixels per tile.
- `center: Vector2`: World point (x, z) at the screen centre.
- `hover_tile: int`: Tile under the cursor (-1 when none) and the hover card's lines (title, detail).

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext, p_hud: Node) -> void`
- `func bind(p_model: MinimapModel) -> void`: Binds the tile model (null hides the map and refuses to open).
- `func is_open() -> bool`: True while the map shows.
- `func open() -> bool`: Opens the map centred on the player (pushes &"map"). False when it may not open now.
- `func close() -> void`: Closes the map and pops its modal (safe when closed).
- `func screen_to_world(p: Vector2) -> Vector2`: World point (x, z) under a screen point of this Control.
- `func world_to_screen(w: Vector2) -> Vector2`: Screen point of a world point (x, z).
- `func click_at(p: Vector2) -> void`: A left click at screen point p: sets the waypoint there, or clears it when p is on it.
- `func zoom_at(p: Vector2, factor: float) -> void`: Zooms by factor about screen point p.
- `func hover_at(p: Vector2) -> PackedStringArray`: Updates the hover card for screen point p: an incident or the waypoint under the cursor, else the tile's place label with its district and distance. Returns the card's lines.
- `func hover_lines() -> PackedStringArray`: The hover card's lines (empty when it is hidden).

## `scripts/fp/ui/minimap_model.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The minimap's tile images (slice B), one pixel per tile of the 192 x 192 world: `image` holds the display colour, `data` the shape class, level and district the map shader draws from (roads joined to their neighbours, inset buildings, smooth shores), and `survey` one texel per 16 x 16 plot (unsurveyed land is hazed). Repainted per tile on tiles_changed, per district on territory_changed, in full only on world_ready.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `CLS_LAND = 0`
- `CLS_ROAD = 1`
- `CLS_WATER = 2`
- `CLS_PARK = 3`
- `CLS_FOREST = 4`
- `CLS_LOT = 5`
- `CLS_BUILDING = 6`
- `CLS_SERVICE = 7`
- `CLS_SITE = 8`
- `CLS_RUBBLE = 9`
- `CLS_BRIDGE = 10`
- `CLS_LANDMARK = 11`
- `COL_LAND = Color(0.125, 0.145, 0.165)`
- `COL_WILD = Color(0.105, 0.12, 0.14)`
- `COL_WATER = Color(0.125, 0.265, 0.365)`
- `COL_ROAD = Color(0.86, 0.88, 0.91)`
- `COL_PARK = Color(0.19, 0.30, 0.215)`
- `COL_FOREST = Color(0.135, 0.19, 0.16)`
- `COL_SITE = Color(0.36, 0.31, 0.245)`
- `COL_RUBBLE = Color(0.27, 0.255, 0.245)`
- `COL_SERVICE = Color(0.30, 0.295, 0.375)`
- `COL_LANDMARK = Color(0.44, 0.39, 0.27)`
- `ZONE_COLORS = { D.ZONE_R: Color(0.255, 0.315, 0.285), D.ZONE_C: Color(0.255, 0.295, 0.37), D.ZONE_I: ...`: Zone building colours at level 2; level 1 is a little darker, level 3 a little lighter.
- `LEVEL_SHADE = [0.82, 0.92, 1.0, 1.12]`
- `LANDMARKS = [D.HALL, D.STADIUM, D.UNIVERSITY, D.AIRPORT]`
- `PLOTS_X = D.W / D.PLOT`
- `PLOTS_Y = D.H / D.PLOT`
- `KEYS = 8192`: Size of the tile-state lookup: kind (5 bits), level (2), terrain (2), district + 1 (4).

### Properties

- `image: Image`: Display colour per tile (RGBA8, 192 x 192).
- `data: Image`: Shape data per tile: r = class, g = level, b = flags (1 = burning), a = district + 1.
- `survey: Image`: One texel per plot: 255 surveyed, 0 hazed.
- `repainted_count: int`: Test hook: tiles painted since the last reset_counters().
- `full_repaints: int`: Test hook: full repaints so far.
- `last_full_ms: float`: Milliseconds the last full repaint took.

### Functions

- `func setup(p_sim: CitySim) -> void`: Creates blank images and textures for p_sim (paint them with full_repaint()).
- `func full_repaint() -> void`: Repaints every tile and plot (world_ready only; budget 15 ms). Runs of equal tile state reuse the previous lookup, and the words go to the images in one native conversion.
- `func repaint(indices: PackedInt32Array, upload: bool = true) -> void`: Repaints only the given tiles (tiles_changed). upload = false leaves the GPU copy to flush(), so several changes in one frame upload once.
- `func flush() -> void`: Uploads the images to their textures.
- `func repaint_district(mi: int, upload: bool = true) -> void`: Repaints the tiles of district mi (plus a one-tile rim) and the survey haze (territory_changed).
- `static func tile_class(k: int, l: int, t: int) -> int`: Shape class of a tile from its kind, level and terrain.
- `static func tile_color(k: int, l: int, t: int, d: int) -> Color`: Display colour of a tile (before the shader's haze).
- `static func land_color(d: int) -> Color`: Ground colour of district d (-1 = unclaimed wilderness): a faint wash of the mayor's colour.
- `static func pixel_of(x: int, y: int) -> Vector2i`: Image pixel of world tile (x, y).
- `func reset_counters() -> void`: Zeroes the test counters.

## `scripts/fp/ui/minimap_view.gd`

extends `Control`

The rotating circular minimap (slice B) in minimap_slot: the model's 192 x 192 tile images drawn by ui/fp/map.gdshader in a 200 px circle (soft edge, thin ring, no square frame), rotated every frame so the view heading points up, with markers drawn on top at 12 Hz (player arrow, waypoint, pings, incidents, nearby residents and E's agents) and the street label under it. Without a bound model (no hud_widgets feature) only the street label shows.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `MinimapModel = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/minimap_model.gd")`
- `MAP_SHADER = preload("res://ui/fp/map.gdshader")`
- `DIAM = 200.0`
- `PAD = 12.0`: Pixels around the circle inside the map rect: the shader draws the soft shadow there.
- `ORIGIN = Vector2(8.0, 0.0)`: The circle's top-left inside the slot: the slot starts 16 px from the screen edge, so 8 more puts the circle on the 24 px safe margin.
- `SCALES = [2.0, 3.5, 6.0]`: Pixels per tile; the wheel steps through them in first person only (in third person it is A's zoom).
- `DEFAULT_SCALE = 3.5`
- `MARKER_PERIOD = 1.0 / 12.0`
- `PEOPLE_PERIOD = 0.5`
- `NEAR_TILES = 20.0`: Residents and agents within this many tiles are drawn.
- `LABEL_Y = 216.0`
- `LABEL_H = 20.0`
- `LABEL_FADE = 0.3`
- `RIM_PAD = 9.0`
- `CAR_COL = Color(0.55, 0.66, 0.8)`: Car blips: a steel blue that stands apart from the white roads and the dark blocks.
- `WALKER_COL = Color(0.86, 0.9, 0.96, 0.45)`

### Properties

- `ppt: float`: Pixels per tile.
- `yaw: float`: View yaw (radians, S0 §11 convention); the map rotates by +yaw.
- `center: Vector2`: World point (x, z) at the circle's centre.
- `marker_draws: int`: Test hook: marker redraws so far.

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext, p_hud: Node) -> void`: hud is the FpHud (pings and the waypoint come from it).
- `func bind(p_model: MinimapModel) -> void`: Shows the model's images (the hud_widgets feature binds it; null unbinds).
- `func center_in_slot() -> Vector2`: The circle's centre in slot coordinates.
- `func world_to_slot(p: Vector3) -> Vector2`: Where world point p is drawn, in slot coordinates, through the map's own Control transform.
- `func map_rect() -> TextureRect`: The map Control (tests read its rotation and visibility).
- `func street_text() -> String`: The street label text.
- `func step_scale(dir: int) -> void`: Steps the scale through SCALES (dir +1 zooms in); clamped at the ends.
- `func refresh_street() -> void`: Re-reads the street name now (after a load or teleport).
